description: Is this platform connected? If yes, returns the account. If not, returns connectUrl: the page that opens the platform's consent screen. Give it to the user — that consent is the only human step, once per platform; they must be signed in to the same StoryShort account as this API key — then call this again every 10 seconds (pollAfterSeconds) until connected is true and continue on your own. The link is not single-use and holds no secret. YouTube and TikTok need a paid plan (PLAN_UPGRADE_REQUIRED otherwise). Requires the "video:read" scope. Free.
name: get_connection_status
title: Check a platform connection
